name: phonebridge-relay
description: Stateless relay that exposes PhoneBridge devices to MCP clients by tunneling Streamable HTTP over a device WebSocket.

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['dist', 'build-test']) require('node:fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test build-test/test/*.test.js
